name: SendMessagePacket
nameBoundary: The client handles this opcode inline in the central dispatcher and carries no RTTI class or source name for it. The catalog name is the established row name and not a client symbol.

route.rangeCheck: The dispatcher skips the jump table when the opcode minus 2 exceeds 0xE3.
dispatchGates: The dispatcher returns without dispatching when the byte at dispatcher+0x54B is nonzero and the opcode is not 0x0004.
The dispatcher returns without dispatching when FUN_00575740 on dispatcher+0x510 returns nonzero and the opcode is not 0x0004.
pointerAdjustments: The dispatcher receives the 16-byte game-message header at offset +0x10 from the start of the subpacket.
The case adds +0x10 to that pointer before the string copies, so every field offset below is relative to the application start.

framing.extentCheck: The case carries no packet-extent argument and performs no length check before reading through application offset 0x223.

fields.name: senderName
fields.read: Copied for exactly 0x20 bytes into a client string by FUN_00447260. The string gains a NUL after the copied bytes, so a full field is bounded without an in-field NUL.

fields.name: displayType
fields.read: Zero-extended word load that becomes the first argument of FUN_004D8560. The two bytes at application+0x22 are not read.

fields.name: unread22
fields.read: Not read by the case or by FUN_004D8560.

fields.name: text
fields.read: Copied for exactly 0x200 bytes into a client string by FUN_00447260. The string gains a NUL after the copied bytes, so a full field is bounded without an in-field NUL.

fields.name: unreadTail
fields.read: Beyond the last byte the case reads.

stringHandling.copy: FUN_00447260 with an explicit length copies that many bytes without scanning for a NUL and sets the string size to length plus one. Passing -1 would scan for a NUL instead, and this case does not.
stringHandling.senderUtf8: FUN_00445C70 validates the sender as UTF-8 up to its first NUL and rejects the line on malformed sequences.
stringHandling.textControlPass: FUN_00C99E80 runs FUN_00C99B80 over the text as a NUL-terminated string, so the first NUL ends the processed text. A failed pass rejects the line. A successful pass replaces the text string with the processed copy. The control-sequence rules are those recorded for World chat in xivl-client-structs:manifests/chat_wire_contract.json#validation.controlEncoding.
stringHandling.paddingIntoLine: FUN_004CE760 joins the sender and text with the size fields of their strings. The sender keeps all 0x20 copied bytes, so padding after a short name is carried into the stored line. How the stored-line reader treats those bytes is not established.

steps: FUN_00C99E80 on the text with the dispatcher+0x7F8 object. A zero result rejects the line.
FUN_00445C70 on the sender. A zero result rejects the line.
FUN_004C3DD0 with the dispatcher+0x950 object. A nonzero result rejects the line.
FUN_004CE760 on the log module at dispatcher+0x660 when that pointer is nonzero. The function returns 1 whether or not the module exists.

nameList.match: A nonempty sender equal to any list entry, compared bytewise up to the NUL, rejects the line.
nameList.producer: FUN_004CDCF0 fills the list from the 0x01CB payload.

logModule.createdBy: FUN_004DC5D0, reached from the 0x0002 case of the same dispatcher
logModule.storedLine: Uppercase four-digit hex of displayType, a colon, the sender, a colon, then the text. The format string is at 0x00F8D638 and the colon string is copied into 0x0132F330 by the initializer at 0x00F076E0.
logModule.append: FUN_00C9A8E0 calls vtable slot 7 (FUN_00C9AD40), which appends the line and returns its running index. The log keeps 0x4B0 lines.
logModule.categoryRings: The vector at module+0x4C (begin +0x50, end +0x54) holds one 0x14-byte queue per displayType. FUN_004CE760 grows it to displayType+1 entries through FUN_004D56F0, appends the line index to the queue for displayType, then drops queued indexes older than the oldest retained line.
logModule.typeBounds: No whitelist, clamp, or zero substitution applies to displayType on this route. World 0x00CB substitutes 3 for zero and this opcode does not.

knownDisplayTypes.source: FUN_004D6E50 logs a client-generated line with the literal sender system.
FUN_004D8D10 passes 3 for received World tell 0x00C8.

capture.boundary: Sender and text are empty in every retained sample and bytes 0x22 through 0x227 are zero. The capture fixes the size and the displayType value 0x1D at application+0x20 only. The sender and text offsets rest on the receiver.

open: The category named by displayType 0x1D and the readers of the per-category queues are not traced.
How the stored-line reader treats NUL padding after a short sender is not traced.
Whether an upstream framing guard rejects a subpacket shorter than 0x224 application bytes is not traced.
